item.title: The Gabonese Republic National Day
item.dc:creator: Marco Rubio, Secretary of State
item.description:
Marco Rubio, Secretary of State

The Gabonese Republic National Day

Press Statement

August 16, 2026

On behalf of the United States, I am pleased to extend warm congratulations to the people of Gabon as you celebrate the 66th anniversary of your independence on August 17.

Our growing commercial ties and deepening security cooperation reflect a shared commitment to a stable, prosperous, and sovereign Gabon.

As Gabon looks toward its future, the United States stands as a steadfast partner. We wish the Gabonese people health, peace, and continued prosperity in the year ahead.

item.title: Indonesia Independence Day
item.dc:creator: Marco Rubio, Secretary of State
item.description:
Marco Rubio, Secretary of State

Indonesia Independence Day

Press Statement

August 16, 2026

On behalf of the people of the United States of America, I extend my warmest congratulations on the 81st anniversary of Indonesia’s independence.

The United States and Indonesia enjoy an enduring partnership rooted in dedication to democratic governance and a shared vision for a free and open Indo-Pacific. Our Comprehensive Strategic Partnership reflects the depth of our cooperation – from defense and regional security to fair and balanced trade, energy, and technology. The United States looks forward to creating new avenues of opportunity for our nations in priority areas such as critical minerals, maritime security, and the digital economy. We offer our heartfelt congratulations to you and the people of Indonesia as we continue our journey together toward shared prosperity.

We also extend deepest condolences to those who lost loved ones in the devastating earthquake and its aftermath in East Nusa Tenggara. Our thoughts are with those who were injured and all communities affected by this tragedy.

item.title: Liechtenstein National Day
item.dc:creator: Marco Rubio, Secretary of State
item.description:
Marco Rubio, Secretary of State

Liechtenstein National Day

Press Statement

August 15, 2026

On behalf of the United States of America, I congratulate the people of Liechtenstein on your National Day.

The United States maintains a long-standing partnership with Liechtenstein, grounded in a commitment to freedom and cooperation on business and investment. We continue to work together to advance our mutual prosperity and commercial diplomacy goals.

As we look to the year ahead, we remain dedicated to deepening our commercial ties and fostering the innovation and prosperity that benefit both our peoples. On this National Day, I extend my best wishes to the people of Liechtenstein.

item.title: The Republic of the Congo National Day
item.dc:creator: Marco Rubio, Secretary of State
item.description:
Marco Rubio, Secretary of State

The Republic of the Congo National Day

Press Statement

August 15, 2026

On behalf of the United States, I extend our congratulations to the people of the Republic of the Congo on the 66th anniversary of its independence.

We are proud of our historic collaboration, which began over six decades ago when the United States recognized the Republic of the Congo on the day of its independence. I look forward to furthering our partnership by strengthening our countries’ commercial and security relationship for the welfare of our citizens.

The United States wishes the Republic of the Congo a prosperous year ahead.

item.title: India Independence Day
item.dc:creator: Marco Rubio, Secretary of State
item.description:
Marco Rubio, Secretary of State

India Independence Day

Press Statement

August 14, 2026

On behalf of the United States of America, I extend warm congratulations to the people of India on their Independence Day.

Thanks to the personal relationship between President Trump and Prime Minister Modi, the U.S.-India relationship continues to grow and is stronger than ever. From defense and energy security to critical minerals, artificial intelligence, space cooperation, and commerce, our collaboration is making both of our nations, and the broader Indian Ocean region, safer, stronger, and more prosperous.

The deep ties of friendship and family between our two peoples form the foundation of a partnership that is innovative, resilient, and forward-looking. The United States looks forward to the future our two countries will build together.

item.title: Trump Administration Announces Additional Support Following Colombia Earthquake
item.dc:creator: Office of the Spokesperson
item.description:
Office of the Spokesperson

Trump Administration Announces Additional Support Following Colombia Earthquake

Media Note

August 14, 2026

The Trump Administration is leading a life-saving response to the devastating 7.4 magnitude earthquake that struck Colombia on August 10.  Today, the Department of State is announcing $11 million in additional humanitarian assistance, bringing the total U.S. assistance following the earthquake to $26.5 million.  The Department is also leveraging support from the U.S. Department of War (DoW) U.S. Southern Command (SOUTHCOM) to transport relief supplies from the Department of State’s Miami prepositioning warehouse to Colombia.  The State Department continues to coordinate with Colombian President Abelardo de la Espriella and the Colombian government to assess and respond to earthquake-related needs.

Additional Life-Saving Humanitarian Assistance

The Department of State is mobilizing a total of $26.5 million – including today’s announcement of an additional $11 million – in humanitarian food, health, protection and shelter assistance, in addition to post-earthquake structural assessments through trusted partners, including Catholic Relief Services (CRS), the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies, the International Organization for Migration (IOM), Miyamoto International, UNICEF, the UN World Food Program (WFP), and World Vision.  Of the initial $15.5 million in assistance announced on August 11, $3 million provided through CRS draws from the previously announced CRS global assistance award.  Additionally, as part of the Department’s $3.8 billion contribution to the UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) announced earlier this year, the United States provided $200 million to the Colombia Pooled Fund, which OCHA can use to address earthquake-related needs as well as preexisting humanitarian needs in Colombia.

Leveraging DoW Support to Deliver Relief Supplies

The Department of State is also leveraging support from SOUTHCOM to transport relief supplies from the Department’s Miami prepositioning warehouse to Colombia.  The first of the planned flights is scheduled to depart Homestead Air Force Base in Florida’s Miami-Dade County today, carrying shelter and water and hygiene supplies.  Upon arrival in Colombia, IOM and WFP will receive the supplies and oversee last-mile distribution to Colombians impacted by the earthquake.  Today’s flight will include hundreds of Starlink kits that will provide reliable, high-speed internet to many humanitarian organizations and the Colombian government to facilitate their relief efforts.  The delivery of these kits will occur in coordination with the State Department, following the disaster response coordination memorandum of understanding signed between Starlink and the Department earlier this summer.

Arrival of Urban Search and Rescue (USAR) Technical Support Teams

In coordination with the Colombian government, the Department of State activated and deployed two USAR technical support teams from the fire departments of Fairfax County, Virginia, and Los Angeles County, California.  These teams arrived in Colombia on August 12 and are providing USAR coordination, communications, and structural engineering support to Colombian government-led search and rescue operations.

Supporting Americans in Colombia

The Trump Administration has no higher priority than the safety and security of Americans.  The State Department is working tirelessly to provide consular assistance to U.S. citizens and their families in the affected areas.  Americans in Colombia should enroll in the Smart Traveler Enrollment Program (STEP) at STEP.state.gov to receive safety and security updates from the U.S. Embassy.  They should follow @TravelGov and @USEmbassyBogota on social media for the latest information.  The Department’s Bureau of Consular Affairs maintains a call center for Americans seeking information or assistance in connection with the Colombia earthquake: call 888-407-4747 from within the United States or Canada, or +1 202-501-4444 from all other locations.

item.title: Republic of Korea National Day
item.dc:creator: Marco Rubio, Secretary of State
item.description:
Marco Rubio, Secretary of State

Republic of Korea National Day

Press Statement

August 14, 2026

On behalf of the Government of the United States of America, I extend my warm congratulations to the Korean people as you celebrate your national day.

For more than seven decades, the United States and the Republic of Korea have cultivated an alliance grounded in shared values, mutual trust, and an unwavering commitment to each other’s security and prosperity. Following the President’s historic state visit to the ROK last fall, the United States and the ROK have ushered in a historic new era in our relationship, deepening cooperation on a range of issues, including economic security, critical minerals, and shipbuilding. The United States remains proud to stand with the ROK, an indispensable partner, as we continue working together to expand prosperity and support the extraordinary people-to-people ties that bind our nations together.

May this occasion be one of great joy and lasting peace.

item.title: Joint Statement on the Sixth Meeting of the Joint Security Coordination Mechanism for the Peace Agreement Between the Democratic Republic of the Congo and the Republic of Rwanda
item.dc:creator: Office of the Spokesperson
item.description:
Office of the Spokesperson

Joint Statement on the Sixth Meeting of the Joint Security Coordination Mechanism for the Peace Agreement Between the Democratic Republic of the Congo and the Republic of Rwanda

Media Note

August 13, 2026

The text of the following statement was released by the Governments of the United States of America, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Republic of Rwanda, the State of Qatar, the Republic of Togo (as the African Union mediator), and the African Union Commission on the occasion of the sixth Joint Security Coordination Mechanism meeting held this week in Geneva, Switzerland.

Begin text.

On August 12-13, 2026, representatives from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Rwanda (the Parties), along with the United States, Qatar, Togo (as the African Union mediator) and the African Union Commission convened the sixth meeting of the Joint Security Coordination Mechanism (JSCM) at the U.S. Mission in Geneva, Switzerland.

The DRC and Rwanda agreed to advance two initiatives to strengthen monitoring and verification of Washington Accords implementation on the ground. The parties requested that the United States consider these two initiatives and provide feedback at the next JSCM. The parties agreed to a trilateral planning conference in October 2026 that will culminate in a revised Operations Order guiding their coordinated efforts.

The African Union Commission presented on the outcomes of the African Union High-Level Meeting in Gaborone, Botswana, held July 24-25, 2026.

The DRC presented its Disarmament, Demobilization, and Reintegration (DDR) Plan for the Forces Démocratiques de Libération du Rwanda (FDLR) and responded to questions from JSCM members. Following the DRC’s presentation, the JSCM held a virtual session with the United Nations Organization Stabilization Mission in the DRC (MONUSCO) to draw on its operational experience conducting DDR in the region.

The Governments of the DRC and Rwanda expressed their appreciation to the United States, Qatar, Togo, and the African Union Commission for their support throughout the peace process and agreed to reconvene for the next JSCM on September 16 –17 in Geneva.

End text.
